units.source_text: 不知是被柏木的语言威力所压倒，

en.t: Whether I had been overwhelmed by the force of Kashiwagi's words,

units.source_text: 还是发自内心的对女人的同情，

en.t: or whether it was sympathy for the woman arising from the bottom of my heart,

units.source_text: 这点连我自己也感到暧昧不清。

en.t: even to me, that point felt vague and unclear.

units.source_text: 反正我立即拔腿跑去追赶她。

en.t: In any case, I immediately broke into a run and went after her.

units.source_text: 从公寓跑过两三栋房子才追赶上。

en.t: I caught up with her only after running two or three houses past the apartment.
